messages.subject: Websocket Problem
parts:
I am trying to run the example RShiny program 01_Hello.

I enter:

runExample("01_hello",host="127.0.0.1",port=8080, launch.browser = TRUE)

in the console and a new tab opens in Chrome (where I am running RStudio) but the app is greyed out.

I looked at the network log in Chrome and it seems to be a websocket error.

I believe there is an apache proxy that RStudio is running on.

Is this a common problem? Is the solution to configure a reverse proxy?
